set.body: Observed in hash-bound Sherlock NN03 baseline-20260919-nn03-v2, both retained runs: 94 of 2495 parsed word indices lie outside all 173 segment spans: 61 'and', 33 'And'. Every gap is between consecutive units and matches the and+pronoun/determiner split rule in recall/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/recall/segmenter.scala (Some(1) starts after and). No R import/index error; all 173 unit text hashes and word spans verify. Make lexical coverage explicit: preferably retain connective in following segment, or model boundary words explicitly. Version the segmentation policy; preserve retained baseline bytes and compare new segmentation/mappings rather than rewriting historical outputs. Acceptance: synthetic boundary tests, every lexical token assigned or explicitly accounted for, timing provenance preserved, fixture replay with old/new hashes and counts. Reproducer in sibling storymodel/tools/evaluation/audit-recall-word-gaps.py SCALA_ROOT; audit docs/viewer-mapping-audit.md. No participant text or datasets copied.
set.title: Preserve or explicitly account for connective words at recall clause boundaries
